subject: general
question:
Whose famous quote is this?

"If you cry because the sun has gone out of your life, your tears will prevent you from seeing the stars."
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rabindranath Tagore**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rabindranath Tagore** is the author of the famous quote: "If you cry because the sun has gone out of your life, your tears will prevent you from seeing the stars."
 
• Rabindranath Tagore was a renowned Indian poet, writer, composer, and painter.
 
• He became the first non-European to win the **Nobel Prize in Literature** in 1913.
 
• Tagore's works reshaped Bengali literature and music, as well as Indian art with Contextual Modernism in the late 19th and early 20th centuries.
 
• He is also the author of the Indian national anthem, "Jana Gana Mana."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Rabindranath Tagore was born on **7th May 1861** in Calcutta, India.
 
• He was a key figure in the Bengali Renaissance and made significant contributions to the cultural and intellectual life of India.
 
• Tagore founded the Visva-Bharati University in Santiniketan, West Bengal, which aimed to bridge the gap between the East and the West through education and culture.
 
• He is also known for his profound influence on the Indian independence movement and his close association with Mahatma Gandhi.
 
• Tagore's literary works include novels, short stories, songs, dance-dramas, and essays covering topics ranging from political issues to personal reflection.
